summary: Unified the Ask page around deterministic-first routing with a read-only CLI-backed conversational fallback, recent-history context, and a separate bounded conversation quota lane. Existing executable actions remain on the deterministic confirm-and-recheck path, and the prior Windows line-ending validation failure is fixed portably.
risks: The conversation request budget is intentionally in memory and resets when the API restarts; both lanes still consume the same underlying provider subscription.

The unfiltered suite's pre-existing ProcessRunnerTests require a POSIX shell with sleep/touch; this restricted Windows session's Git shell could not locate those utilities, so the final full-solution run excluded that unrelated fixture.
